gate_failures.reason: Zika risk here is classified moderate-or-above — still shown with informed precautions (repellent, covering up, avoiding standing water) recommended, but capped rather than top-ranked given the risk in pregnancy. Was a hard exclusion until 2026-07-14; softened because it was silently removing every major city with excellent obstetric care (e.g. Bangkok) from results entirely. Cap raised from 0.45 to 0.55 on 2026-07-15 after checking Bangkok's actual raw (pre-cap) score: 5.99/10, driven by genuinely elite obstetric_care_access (0.93) and hospital_proximity (0.96) — a 0.45 cap was punishing it BELOW its own honest quality and below smaller towns with objectively worse medical infrastructure (Ayutthaya, Kanchanaburi), which is medically backwards. 0.55 lets Bangkok's real strength surface and beat lesser-resourced small towns, while staying below cities with BOTH lower Zika classification and better comfort profiles (Hua Hin, Chiang Mai) — Zika prevention still matters (a nearby hospital cannot reverse Zika-related birth defects, unlike e.g. a fall injury), so this is a real cap, not a bypass.

gate_failures.reason: Zika risk here is classified moderate-or-above — still shown with informed precautions (repellent, covering up, avoiding standing water) recommended, but capped rather than top-ranked given the risk in pregnancy. Was a hard exclusion until 2026-07-14; softened because it was silently removing every major city with excellent obstetric care (e.g. Bangkok) from results entirely. Cap raised from 0.45 to 0.55 on 2026-07-15 after checking Bangkok's actual raw (pre-cap) score: 5.99/10, driven by genuinely elite obstetric_care_access (0.93) and hospital_proximity (0.96) — a 0.45 cap was punishing it BELOW its own honest quality and below smaller towns with objectively worse medical infrastructure (Ayutthaya, Kanchanaburi), which is medically backwards. 0.55 lets Bangkok's real strength surface and beat lesser-resourced small towns, while staying below cities with BOTH lower Zika classification and better comfort profiles (Hua Hin, Chiang Mai) — Zika prevention still matters (a nearby hospital cannot reverse Zika-related birth defects, unlike e.g. a fall injury), so this is a real cap, not a bypass.
